base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original polished high fidelity art-direction mockup for Chinese historical strategy RPG 风云南北朝, Northern and Southern Dynasties, around 546 CE. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger same aspect. Cohesive restrained hand-painted ink and mineral wash game art, weathered woven dark ink-green #1c2721, warm fiber paper #e5dcc5, muted old bronze #a78c52, clear warm ivory text on dark and charcoal text on paper, small restrained cinnabar accents. Refined thin borders and irregular ink-brushed exterior, not massive medieval metal UI. All controls fit coherent compact typography, body 14 logical px, titles 24, short icon-plus-text horizontal tabs 38 high, square X close 32, action buttons 36. Selected tab is irregular pale-paper brush strip, no gold rectangle slabs. Buttons paper/ink secondary and oldgold only final confirm; accessible disabled and selected states distinct. Chinese text rendered carefully. No English, no emoji, no modern SaaS, no neon, no progress bars without actual progress, no gratuitous icon circles, no European heraldic shields, no crowns atop coats of arms, no Japanese mon or samurai flags, no Qing dragon robes or modern PRC symbols. Tiny bottom caption: 设计预览 · 非实机 · 数值示意.

No English, no emoji, no modern SaaS, no neon, no progress bars without actual progress, no gratuitous icon circles, no European heraldic shields, no crowns atop coats of arms, no Japanese mon or samurai flags, no Qing dragon robes or modern PRC symbols. Tiny bottom caption: 设计预览 · 非实机 · 数值示意. DESIGN BOARD 01: title 旌旗与家族印记. This is a material and identity system board not game interface. Upper 45% presents five beautiful cloth government banners hanging from slender bronze-capped wooden crossbars: 梁 deep desaturated jade green, 东魏 smoky mulberry, 西魏 ochre, 齐 variant mulberry, 周 variant ochre. Simple narrow rectangular cloth with lightly split bottom and restrained streamers, upright readable large state name, subtle woven pattern and sparse honeysuckle/lotus border. East and west labels must remain fully distinguishable; do not reduce both to identical 魏. Existing faction colors kept for game readability, not claimed historical heraldry. Lower 35% presents six family seals: 兰陵萧氏 surname 萧, 渤海高氏 surname 高, 河南元氏 surname 元, 武川宇文氏 surname 宇文, 云中独孤氏 surname 独孤, 武川侯莫陈氏 surname 侯莫陈. Every family uses same square seal-derived silhouette, incised seal-style surname on nearblack inkstone/lacquer plaque with modest bronze edge, small ivory name strip beneath, sparse curving honeysuckle motifs; three-character surname in balanced 2x2 arrangement without inventing extra character. Not badge shields or hanging sovereign banners. Show compact 24/40/72 size family icon examples as small strip at bottom with standalone well spaced labels 同族不等于同国 / 姓氏与族源共同识别. Distinguish two 崔 branches in small side comparison 清河崔氏 vs 博陵崔氏 sharing surname but different region text. All material samples tangible and elegant, hierarchy legible, strong empty margin, do not overload fake annotation text. small note 纹样取意于时代器物，标识为游戏演绎.
boards: DESIGN BOARD 02. Two large side-by-side coherent FAMILY DETAIL WINDOW states, title 门第与世系. Left 60% width main family page 兰陵萧氏, right 40% narrow member-contribution page of SAME family. Dark painted ancestral estate/courtyard horizontal header, family square engraved black seal with 萧 and 郡望 · 兰陵 beside it, family rank and prestige as actual style example 族望 320, three small measures 庄园 / 庄户 / 庄粮. Do not depict family seal as sovereign state flag. Tiny current-person allegiance banner 梁 appears beside selected character info separately; never imply whole family belongs to same country. One horizontal tab row 世系 / 贡献, exact same paper brush selection as prior new dialogs. Left panel content on warm paper: elegant branching family tree with small square painted portraits and thin ink connecting lines: 萧道赐 -> 萧顺之 -> 萧衍, then 萧统 / 萧纲 / 萧绎. Selected member beside tree in compact inkgreen dossier shows portrait, name, public identity, clan seal. Bottom clear 查看人物 and 查看家业 navigation, no giant confirm as this is view-only. Right panel same header/seal and tabs with 贡献 selected, ranked member rows and date-stamped prestige ledger, no modern bar dashboard, no massive vertical blank space. Chinese faces Southern Dynasties flat ink portrait art, no crowns except appropriate headwear. Include small isolated corner detail of the SAME seal at 24/40/72 px and note 族徽各处同源. No game mechanics invented. Fine details crisp and implementable.

Left persistent identity column width~190 with 长安, 都城·平原, 汉文化, small upright official half portrait 韩子实 and 长安县令; only one state flag in header not repeated in identity. Across top of main content a compact single metric strip 公款 26371 / 公粮 1324 / 人口 99388 / 秩序100 / 繁荣100 / 县令影响力999 (example values user screenshot). Main body shows fine painted low-walled sixth-century city landscape with clickable structures; below four equal scale but unboxed building artwork entry tiles 市肆 未建 / 城仓 未建 / 驿舍 未建 / 城防 1级. Buildings stand on coherent painted ground, not isolated 3D merchandise. Hovered market tile gets tiny thin bronze underline and nearby short 查看营建 button, not a giant card. Right side a compact preview slip chosen 市肆, requiredconditions/cost tobequoted, button 查看营建; do not execute build on selection.
